message: 宿命や運命
Saturday after school.
Today, we can spend more time on Student Council activities than usual.
...Or so it was supposed to be--

name: Synn
message: 「M-M-Mi-Misa... Cristelis-san, here's the meeting agenda and the approval request for the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't you just call her Misa like normal?」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes, here you go, Synn Sakura-kun.」

name: Ria
message: 「And she's using his full name...」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa... Brigitta-san, here are the event survey forms.」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh...? Ah, ugh... M-Mgh, kii...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now, that won't do. The Vice President is far too self-conscious about the President being the Demon Lord.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-Th-Th... That's not true at all...!」

name: Helena
message: 「Sakura-chan, Sakura-chan, you've been requested at Table 3.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What is Big Sis talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's Helena-san's code. She's calling me over.」

name: Ria
message: 「And she's broadcasting a secret code like that over the whole school PA...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Well then, I'm clocking out for today, so I'll leave the rest to you guys...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where are you going?」

name: Synn
message: 「To see the drill sergeant.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And who might that be, and where?」

name: Misa
message: 「She means Melilot-san.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh? Synn-kun and Misa-chan really are on the same wavelength, aren't they.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm heading out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, I'm sitting on pins and needles here...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just goes to show how much you liked Hisu.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't talk about it in the past tense. It's not over yet!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, I mean... I got dumped, so I shouldn't keep dragging this out and should just give up... I know that, but.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If that's what you wanna do, Synn-sama, then give up.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Paqy, you cheered me up last night, so you're not gonna back me up today, huh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Both Your Majesty and Hisu are showing up to the academy properly, ain't ya? And you're even doing your Student Council work right.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't nothing left for me to butt into.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... You're right, I have to get over this on my own.」
I came to the library to have Melilot-san train me.
It's supposed to be open to the public on weekends and draw plenty of outside visitors, yet today there isn't a single soul around.

name: Melilot
message: 「You arrived quite early. That is an admirable attitude.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there was a broadcast... Ah!」
It finally dawns on me now. Helena-san sees right through everything.
If I have the spare time to mope and agonize over Misa, I should focus on my training--that's probably what she meant.

name: Melilot
message: 「Did something happen with a broadcast? No outside sounds can be heard at all in this training ground.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? W-We're doing the Demon Lord training here? Aren't we renting out the martial arts hall...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「A building like that is far too fragile to withstand the shockwaves of magic. Practical training will be conducted outdoors.」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's that dangerous... wouldn't the library collapse too?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, please rest assured. A barrier has been cast over this space. At your current level, Sakura-kun, your power cannot break it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Neither our figures nor our voices inside this barrier can be perceived from the outside, and vice versa.」

name: Synn
message: 「No wonder... Even though it's open to the public on weekends, I thought it was weird that nobody was around the library.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please train to your heart's content without worrying about your surroundings.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, let us begin. Prepare yourself.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Melilot-san, you're going to be instructing me? I totally assumed some kind of master would show up...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Could it be that Helena told you nothing at all?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, not a single word.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Ahem.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I belong to a clan that records Re-Crea and monitors its state. Those around us also call us the Nive Clan, though--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Just like you, I am a demon.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Melilot-san, you too...!?」
I see... The person who could use magic, the one who guided us through yesterday's magic circle, was Melilot-san all along.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why are you working as a librarian?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Does it strike you as strange? Some work at beef bowl shops, and others have become boiler operators, have they not?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In the very same way, I simply wished to be a librarian.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... right. No wonder there are all sorts of rumors about Nive-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am not particularly fond of being called Nive. Please continue to call me Melilot, just as you always have.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now, regarding last night's matter--I feel terribly sorry for exposing your identity as the Demon Lord in front of everyone involved.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There were indeed ways to deal with Re-Crea while keeping the fact that Sakura-kun is the Demon Lord a secret, however...」

name: Synn
message: 「So Helena-san decided on her own to reveal the secret over oden?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It was not Helena alone. I also advised her to do so.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because magic is influenced by the caster's state of mind.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. It may be painful for you right now, but considering what lies ahead, it was an unavoidable course of action.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I don't have to deceive Everyone anymore. That's one less thing to worry about.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Which means you have other concerns weighing on your mind, do you not?」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is the best advice I can offer, but at times like these, focusing on something else will help take your mind off things, even if only a little.」

name: Synn
message: 「Housework or studying, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ordinarily, perhaps, but right now, please devote yourself to your training as the Demon Lord.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even for the Demon Lord, there is no destiny or fate dictating that you must be a certain kind of person.」

name: Melilot
message: 「No matter who you are, you are you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, gaining strength should not be in vain.」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood. Please guide me strictly.」

name: Melilot
message: 「What are you fooling around for? To think you cannot even control this level of magic power.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hah, hah, hah! I-I'm giving it everything I've got.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Really...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your magic is far too erratic. Activate the magic circle with the exact same mental image as last night.」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But that's--」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!?」
W-Who is this woman? Judging by her appearance, I don't think she's human, though...

name: Melilot
message: 「What business do you have here, Soltia? Did I not tell you not to enter without permission?」

name: Soltia
message: 「How cold of you, even though we're allies now.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Well, whatever. There's something I want to look into. Lend me the key to the archive.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Here.」

name: Soltia
message: 「I've certainly borrowed it.」
Surprisingly, Melilot-san tossed the ring of keys at the person called Soltia. Normally, Melilot-san would have handed them over politely...

name: Soltia
message: 「...Hmph.」
Why is this person staring at me with such a nasty look?

name: Soltia
message: 「This is the Demon Lord? This...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is--」

name: Soltia
message: 「In the end, a Demon is still a Demon. Just a ground-crawling subhuman, I see.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia, your business is finished, is it not? Leave the barrier immediately.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Excuse me, then.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Until next time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Who was that...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「--Soltia. She is also one of those who hold the key to averting Re-Crea.」
What cold eyes she has. She didn't look the cooperative type at all, though...

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if our motives differ, as long as our goal is the same, our interests align.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia may seem like an ally, yet she isn't one. Sometimes a friend, sometimes a foe...」

name: Paqy
message: 「They used to be lovers, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As if that could ever be true! Now, let us continue our training!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Something seems to be causing disturbances in your magic.」

name: Synn
message: 「*Huff, puff... huff, puff...* I-It's already night. I didn't even notice.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena\s04 Working hard, you two?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Eh...?! H-How did you get inside the barrier?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Foh-foh-foh-foh, you're still too naive, little Melilot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Why are you approaching me while wiggling the fingers of both hands so lewdly?」

name: Helena
message: 「When you're always feasting on a delicacy like Ria, sometimes you start craving a taste of Melilot instead. You understand, don't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I do not! I refuse!」

name: Helena
message: 「Your mouth says no, Melilot, but deep down you really... Oh my, you pervert~\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「So as not to get in the way, please go to a corner over there and do it by yourself.」

name: Helena
message: 「So meeean!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, we are resuming training!」

name: Helena
message: 「If you push yourselves too hard right from the start, you'll run out of steam halfway through. Call it a day for now.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is a fair point, however...」

name: Helena
message: 「And so... Hey missy, you've got some fine tits on ya. Ufu, ufufufufu.」

name: Melilot
message: 「No means no!! We're already running out of time--」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, come now, what's the harm?♪」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm... I wouldn't want to get in the way of you two, so I'll just head off for today--」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're not going home yet! We're doing magic training until you cough up blood!」

name: Helena
message: 「At least take a break, won't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, break time calls for a show♪ Let's put on a live sex show.\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Tickle, tickle, tickle.\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「W-W-W-W-Wait just a second...!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh? They both vanished.」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Helenaaa, Meliloooot-san!」

name: Synn
message: 「...No answer.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, your voice ain't gonna reach the two of 'em inside from outside a barrier.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-When did I end up outside... Did Melilot-san blast me out with magic?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Means you're good to head home for tonight, doesn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Go get some rest, Demon Lord. You've got training tomorrow too--keep this up and your body's gonna give out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I will.」
